name: Guwahati Spring Cube Open 2023

venue.name: Hustle House
venue.address: 6th Floor, Megha Plaza, Beltola Chariali, Guwahati, Assam 781028

information: * Make sure to be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. Late entries won't be allowed to participate. * Attend the tutorial session if you're new to WCA competitions or unfamiliar with its rules. * Bring a government ID card for verification if it's your first time participating in a WCA competition. * Participants are expected to volunteer and will be assigned roles as judges, scramblers, or runners, with the exception of newcomers.
